messages.author: fac3a3801ac6dde1
messages.subject: Question about coord_trans (possibly bug 75)
parts:
Hi all

I have a problem with the coord_trans function. Here's a reproducible
plot the looks fine:

dsmall = diamonds[sample(nrow(diamonds),1000),]
c <- ggplot(dsmall, aes(clarity, price, colour = factor(color)))
c + stat_summary(fun.ymin=min,fun.ymax=max, geom="errorbar")

Now if I want to transform the y axis to log scale, the x axis gets
messed up:

dsmall = diamonds[sample(nrow(diamonds),1000),]
c <- ggplot(dsmall, aes(clarity, price, colour = factor(color)))
c + stat_summary(fun.ymin=min,fun.ymax=max, geom="errorbar")
+coord_trans(y="log")

After some searching, I found that is could possibly be bug 75.
(http://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues/issue/75)

Is that correct? And if yes, @hadley any idea when this might be
fixed? Of course everybody wants their bugs fixed first, but it seems
to me that a log transformation of the y axis is one of the most
common transformation in scientific plots. I'm also curious to learn
if theres a way around it with the current version (ggplot2_0.8.7).

Thanks!
Marcel
